common_part.cm4_title: Social behavior in ASD males: The interplay between cognitive flexibility, working memory, and functional connectivity deviations

cm6_clarity_of_research_objectives.reason: The abstract and introduction clearly state the objective to model normative trajectories of between-network rsFC in non-ASD males, apply them to ASD males to compute individual deviation scores, test associations with social behavior, and examine mediation by executive function.
cm6_clarity_of_research_objectives.supporting_text: Using neuroimaging data from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE), we modeled normative trajectories of between-network resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) in non-ASD males across childhood (n = 321). These normative charts were then applied to ASD males (n = 418) to calculate individual deviation scores (z-scores)... Cognitive flexibility and working memory mediated the association between VANxDMN z-scores and social behavioral problems.

common_part.cm7_additional_comments: Study focuses exclusively on males aged 5.1–14 years from ABIDE I/II; analyses conducted in R with mgcv, PMA, mediation, and neuroCombat.

nm1_clear_definition_of_target_populatio.reason: The study defines the population as males aged 5.1–14.0 years from ABIDE I and II, with ASD and non-ASD controls; demographics and rationale for focusing on males are provided.
nm1_clear_definition_of_target_populatio.supporting_text: Data for the current study were from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and ABIDE II... only males between ages 5.1 -14.0 years were included in this study (n = 816)... We focused exclusively on males due to the increased prevalence of ASD in males... and the sex differences observed in neurodevelopmental trajectories.

nm3_handling_of_confounding_variables.reason: Site effects were harmonized with ComBat; mean relative motion was included as a covariate; sex was controlled by restricting to males; a sensitivity analysis included IQ as covariate.
nm3_handling_of_confounding_variables.supporting_text: To account for site effects, we employed the ComBat harmonization method... Mean relative motion over all volumes was extracted and included as a co-variate in normative models... We focused exclusively on males... We performed sensitivity analyses correcting for IQ and observed similar mediation estimates (Supplementary Table 6).
